name: Mattel
outlook:
What Mattel says to expect

  • Full year 2026: guidanceFor the full year 2026, the Company now expects: • Net Sales growth in the range of 1% to 4% in constant currency, • Adjusted Gross Margin of roughly 48%, • Adjusted Operating Income in the range of $500 million to $570 million, and • Adjusted EPS in the range of $1.05 - $1.20.
  • Full year 2026: currency effect and tax rateForeign Exchange is expected to have a roughly 1% benefit on full year Net Sales based on current spot rates, and the Adjusted Effective Tax Rate is expected to be roughly 23% for the full year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
